name: agentmesh-suite
description: 7 standalone Rust & Go microservices for AI coding agents: AST code intelligence, 3.4ms microVM sandboxes, deterministic syntax patchers, test impact bisection, episodic memory graphs, visual layout evaluation, and cryptographic security vaults.

servers.name: symbol-graph
servers.description: High-throughput AST symbol indexing, definition lookup, and cross-file call graphs (<20ms SLA).

servers.name: sandbox-pool
servers.description: Ephemeral copy-on-write workspace scratchpads, sub-second execution, snapshots & diffs (3.4ms fork).

servers.name: ast-patcher
servers.description: Deterministic AST-aware code transformation, refactoring, and atomic rollback (<8ms SLA).

servers.name: test-oracle
servers.description: Dynamic test impact analysis and automated git commit bisection (<15ms SLA).

servers.name: episodic-memory
servers.description: Semantic knowledge graph, episodic experience recording, and cross-session memory (<10ms SLA).

servers.name: visual-eval
servers.description: Headless browser DOM layout inspection, visual regression pixel-diffing & a11y audits (<50ms SLA).

servers.name: safety-broker
servers.description: Deny-by-default policy enforcement, secret vault proxying, and SHA-256 Merkle audit logs (<5ms SLA).
